articles.summary: Tenaris inaugurated its first private nature reserve, located at the Industrial Center in Campana, Argentina. The reserve covers a 5-hectare area that preserves the region’s native ecosystem and hosts a rich biodiversity of flora and fauna species. Its creation included the development of sustainable infrastructure to support environmental awareness and educational activities, designed and built by students participating in the Gen Técnico Roberto Rocca educational program.
articles.title: Tenaris inaugurates its first private nature reserve

articles.summary: Tenaris has been awarded contracts to supply OCTG, line pipe and coating services for the Cronos gas development offshore Cyprus, operated by Eni in partnership with TotalEnergies.
articles.title: Tenaris awarded tubular package for Cronos gas development in the Eastern Mediterranean

articles.summary: Building on the technological success of the TenarisHydril Blue® and Wedge™ Series connections, the White™ connection combines advanced engineering and manufacturing innovation in a connection designed for the future of well construction. The connection is designed to perform in the most complex applications, including deepwater, HP/HT, horizontal and extended-reach wells where reliability and operational consistency are critical.
articles.title: Tenaris presents the TenarisHydril White™ connection at ADIPEC
